title: FC 802: Definitions
officialText:
802.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

CONIFER.

DECORATION.

FIRE-RETARDANT COATING.

FLAME-RESISTANT MATERIAL.

FLAME-RETARDANT TREATMENT.

FLAME SPREAD.

FURNISHING.

INTERIOR FINISH.

NATURAL DECORATIVE GREEN.

NATURAL TREE.

NATURAL VEGETATION.

SCENERY.
